name: @beautynest/market-report
description: Daily Skincare Market Intelligence MVP v1 - zero-dependency report generator (Google Trends RSS, Reddit public feeds, TikTok Creative Center with static fallback, static Amazon watchlist).
whyNoDependencies: Zero runtime and dev dependencies on purpose: GitHub Actions runs `node src/index.mjs` with no install step, and nothing in this folder can affect the main Next.js site build or its lockfile.
